note: SIMULATED: every number comes from the PETAL Locate simulator and models with illustrative link parameters and nominal orbital slots (config/pacific-uhf.yaml), not from real satellites, terminals or sites.
method: sim.montecarlo.run_trials on the shipped scenario files with their own truth errors (draw_errors=False; only the noise differs between trials, seed 7), pairs by the tasking rule (primary by link-budget C/N0), 1 s captures, uncalibrated and calibrated against the configured reference in the jammer's channel, at eight epochs 3 h apart on 2026-01-01. The shipped scenarios have no ionosphere or troposphere; the solver still carries both at the configured sigmas, so their ellipses are cautious. 'pacific-demo+media' is pacific-demo with a 30 TECU ionosphere and a 2.3 m troposphere at every ground end. The scenario descriptions quote the server's chain as re-implemented in tests/test_sim_verify.py (primary by detected SNR, references captured in a later slot).
